name: GluC time course
prep: All 3,017 observations and eight iTRAQ quantity channels from published supplementary table 1 are retained. Zero retained; empty/NA missing. No scaling or imputation. All eight channels are reported; the comparison is 16 h versus 1 h (one channel each); tests disabled.
fasta_note: 842-record reference FASTA used in the manuscript analysis; not asserted to be the original search database.
